title: Opening Range Breakout
summary: Of the sessions with a formed opening range, how often the range broke — in either or a chosen direction — plus time-to-break. Any derived window works (5/10/15/30/60 by default; add any window to the symbol config). Pair with orb-false-break and orb-target for the failure rate and the extension ladder.
deltas: any opening-range window, not a fixed 5/15/30 menu
false-break and target hit-rate ladders as sibling presets on the same derived columns
compose with any condition: gap state, weekday, event days, volatility regime
